# SYS-002: No reboot pending

- **Group:** System
- **Severity when it fails:** moderate
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

When /var/run/reboot-required exists, an update installed a new kernel or core library that only takes effect after a reboot. Until then the host runs the old, vulnerable code even though the package manager reports it as patched. Pending for more than 14 days fails.

## Verify by hand

```sh
ls -l /var/run/reboot-required; cat /var/run/reboot-required.pkgs
```

## How to fix it

Reboot in a maintenance window, or set an automatic reboot window for unattended upgrades (see UPD-004).

## What a fix can break

A reboot interrupts every service on the host; containers without a restart policy stay down.

Run `stackward explain SYS-002` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
